details:
It's possible that when you log in (in VR), and open up your menu to join a friend or look for a world to start exploring in off from your home world, all of the UI elements (excluding the expression menu, which is hand anchored) including the main menu in both its small and expanded forms, and the chatbox, both can end up permanently crooked (like a 30-45 degree angle, not any specific angle) or inside out (back of the menu is facing the player's head)

I'm not sure what causes this, but it usually happens when logging into VRChat (This can randomly happen when I load in with my headset on, or when I set my headset down and get some FBT trackers on while I'm waiting for VRC to load up, it doesn't seem to matter)

This also happens pretty consistently when I'm in a world that uses seats/stations, for example, a car or a plane (Chikuwa's vehicle system consistently does this to me)

The only way to fix it is to use space drag through OVR and PHYSICALLY space drag or walk in front of the chat box/main menu and physically turn around to get behind it to click anything in my menus or tilt my head sideways to read the contents of the menu. The only actual fix to restore its position is to completely restart VRChat.

Not sure what causes this entirely, but it is to note I use SlimeVR + OVR Advanced Settings (to space drag in front of the inverted menus...) and I am on the Steam version of VRChat. Occurs on stable and beta.

Steam version of VRChat, occurs in Beta and Stable both, has been a bug for probably about a year in all builds. w_2026.4.1-a61ceb9d89- Steam Branch: open-beta

I've had this issue for months, and this has been an issue even after the chatbox rework and applies to both the chat and the menu.
title: UI (Big+Small Main Menu + Chat Box) can end up permanently inside out/tilted/backwards
